editorial_checks: Two separate histories, not equivalent harms or opposite grades. No invented scenes, composite sufferers, private thoughts or dialogue; English independently written, front-end prose without SAE dimension labels.

Ghana's 600,000-dose arrival on 24 February 2021 is a shipment, not a vaccination record or the first vaccine delivery of any kind to Africa. Pune origin, SII manufacture and COVAX's role are verified.

COVAX is a partnership with divided functions, not a world health government. Its initial proportional 3% and 20% benchmarks are initial allocation design, not an overall vaccination ceiling, binding delivery date or control over every global supply contract.

The September 2021 1.425-billion figure is a contemporaneous supply forecast, not actual annual deliveries. The partners' account of constraints is attributed, not used as a contract-by-contract finding of liability. No mortality loss is attributed solely to delay or to COVAX.

2022 demand-led Phase 2 is a revised approach under changed conditions, not silently equated to the 2020 proposed risk-weighted second phase. Expressed demand and health need, shipment count and usability remain distinct.

The existing AMC no-fault compensation programme is acknowledged and limited to eligible vaccine-related harm. No blanket claim that individuals lacked all redress, no implied compensation for delayed supply, and no substitution of government participation for informed individual agreement.

The 2023 closing dose count is the partners' report, not independently adjudicated performance or a count of fully vaccinated people. No modelled deaths-averted estimate or current vaccination recommendation is offered.

Greek referendum 61.31% refers to valid votes. The question concerns the 25 June proposal's two documents, not a direct euro-exit ballot or a permanent veto on all future assistance; voter intentions are not homogenized.

ECB's 28 June 2015 decision held the ELA ceiling, rather than cancelling all support or directly ordering a domestic bank closure. Greek bank-holiday measures and the external constraints interact without being conflated.

Expiry on 30 June, the 8 July new request and 19 August programme start are distinct. New negotiations and approval do not erase the political question of meaningful refusal or make all bargaining positions equal.

2010 bilateral GLF and IMF lending, 2012 EFSF arrangements and the 2015 ESM programme remain distinct. The €86-billion ceiling and €61.9-billion disbursement are loans, not household grants. IMF is not presented as a disbursing lender under the third ESM programme.

IMF's 2013 evaluation is retrospective participant self-evaluation, not proof that all hardship had one cause or a counterfactual that was certain in 2010. No imagined pensioner or ATM scene is supplied.

Koufaki and ADEDY's 7 May 2013 ECtHR inadmissibility decision concerns specific property complaints, not blanket approval of all bailout policies or selection of the best budget. The Court of Human Rights, EU institutions and lenders are separate; a failed challenge is not absence of every remedy.

COVAX stops at 2023 closure; Greece at 2018 programme completion. Later institutional pages are used retrospectively for those events. Completion does not establish universal household recovery or the disappearance of debt and oversight.
